title: Inventory reserve
skill: Describe every symptom and the expected behavior

good: Fix Inventory.reserve(sku, qty) in inventory/service.py and by_priority() in inventory/allocate.py. Rules: use warehouses with priority 1 first, then 2, and so on; with equal priority, sort by name A-Z (by_priority sorts with reverse=True now, which is wrong). Take as much as possible from each warehouse before the next. All or nothing: if the total stock of the sku is less than qty, raise OutOfStock and change no stock (today it raises after it already took stock). qty below 1 raises ValueError and changes nothing. Return [(warehouse name, units taken)] in the order used, only warehouses that gave units. Do not change other files. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Stock reservation is buggy. Fix it.
